Hi Tara — thanks, that looks good. We'll take Tue Apr 6 at 15:00 PT (30m) — enough to confirm MAP ownership and PO steps.

A couple of asks from Redwood to make the call productive:
- Can Acme share a primary billing contact and remit-to address ahead of time? (Devin, if you can confirm)
- Please review the attached Redwood_PROC_Onboarding_Form.pdf and pre-fill sections A+B if possible. Speeding that up helps procurement create the PO.
- Our success criteria for this onboarding: PO issued within 10 business days after kickoff, one test invoice received/approved, and SOC2 evidence uploaded to the shared folder (if flagged).

Proposed agenda (15:00 PT, Tue Apr 6 — 30m):
1) Intros & objectives (5m)
2) Review onboarding checklist & outstanding docs (10m)
3) PO process & billing/contact handoff (10m)
4) Confirm MAP owners & immediate next steps (5m)

I've looped in Laura (procurement ops) and Rishi (legal/compliance) — Laura will run PO cadence and Rishi will flag any contract items.
